title: GH-13 triage: benchmark build failure with modern criterion
description: Make bench1 build reliable on modern criterion and enforce it as a hard CI requirement.
acceptance_criteria: 1) bench/Bench1.hs no longer imports Criterion.Config. 2) bench1 builds successfully on CI and local documented env. 3) CI pipeline fails if bench1 fails. 4) Native dependencies required for bench1 (e.g., snappy/quicklz) are provisioned and documented.
notes: Review result: AC1, AC2, and AC4 are satisfied (Criterion.Config removed; local cabal test properties and cabal build bench1 pass with documented snappy dependency). AC3 is not satisfied yet because .github/workflows/ci.yml has invalid YAML (step 'Install native benchmark dependencies' has mis-indented run block). Verified with ruby YAML parser (Psych::SyntaxError). Next: fix workflow indentation and re-verify CI config parses.

title: GH-12 decision: frame/streaming roadmap and compatibility contract
description: Decision task for GH #12: define API and compatibility policy for streaming/frame support without breaking existing users.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Record explicit compatibility contract: existing compress/decompress semantics remain unchanged. 2) Record scope choice for next implementation slice (framed-only vs full streaming API). 3) Record whether runtime lz4 CLI dependency is acceptable or must be replaced by native bindings. 4) Create/maintain linked implementation task(s) for chosen scope.
notes: Decision recorded: implementation direction is native LZ4F bindings (no runtime lz4 CLI dependency).
close_reason: Decision finalized: native LZ4F bindings; bench1 hard CI; GH #8 closed stale

title: GH-8 triage: storable vector API proposal status
description: Disposition task for GH #8: close as stale by default unless an implementer volunteers with concrete API proposal.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Post a final GitHub comment summarizing stale disposition and reopen criteria. 2) Close GH #8 as stale unless a concrete implementation owner and API sketch are provided. 3) Reopen criteria documented: (a) proposer, (b) API sketch, (c) backward-compatibility plan.
notes: Default policy: stale-close now; reopen when concrete owner + proposal exists.
close_reason: Closed GH #8 as stale with explicit reopen criteria

title: GitHub Open-Issue Follow-up Epic
description: Track and close remaining GitHub follow-up work from issue triage, including implementation, policy decisions, and final GitHub sync.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All child tasks are closed. 2) Each linked GitHub issue has an outcome comment reflecting final disposition. 3) Dependency graph has no cycles. 4) Epic can be closed via br epic close-eligible once children are done.
notes: Validation: run 'br dep cycles --json' (count=0), 'br show br-cg7 --json' (all dependents closed), and verify GitHub issue links/outcomes are recorded in child tasks.

title: GH-12 implementation: native framed/streaming API slice
description: Implement native LZ4 frame support using LZ4F bindings (no runtime lz4 CLI dependency) while preserving legacy compress/decompress behavior.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Framed API uses native LZ4F bindings only (no shelling out to lz4 CLI at runtime). 2) Existing compress/decompress behavior remains backward-compatible. 3) Add interoperability tests with standard lz4 frame payloads. 4) Document migration/usage notes and framing contract.
notes: Validation: search for runtime process execution in framed path (none); cabal test passes; framed interop tests pass against lz4 frame assets.

title: Epic closeout: sync final outcomes back to GitHub issues
description: After implementation/disposition tasks finish, update linked GitHub issues with outcomes and close or leave open with rationale.
acceptance_criteria: 1) GH #13 updated with benchmark outcome. 2) GH #12 updated with roadmap/implementation status. 3) GH #8 closed or updated per stale policy with reopen criteria. 4) Links to br tasks/PRs included in comments.
notes: Validation: record GitHub comment URLs in this task before closing.

title: GH-10 triage: incompatibility with stock lz4 framed files
description: Triage recommendation: KEEP OPEN. Reproduced: data compressed by system lz4 CLI fails to decompress via Codec.Compression.LZ4.decompress (returns Nothing). Current format is library-specific length-prefixed framing and is not wire-compatible with standard LZ4 frame files. Any fix likely requires additive API to avoid breaking current users.
